subject: knot-bodied bird
art_direction: 小鸟身体像打了一个柔软陶结，短喙与尾尖向两边探出。

composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Sculpt an imaginary bird whose body bends into one loose stoneware knot. A short beak and rounded tail emerge on opposite sides, while two tiny feet steady the form. Turn the head back toward the viewer with curious attention. Use warm ochre clay and one muted blue glaze area inside the bend. Light it against cream, emphasizing broad hand-pressed curves rather than feather details. Square 1024x1024, with a clear central silhouette and no circular border. Original peaceful design, no lettering, logos, or watermark.
